purpose: Reconcile all recoverable Google Drive donor content against the current 211-object canonical dataset without treating derived UI payloads or forbidden shooting instructions as canonical facts.

result.migration_loss_summary: No country-monolith object record is missing. Recoverable residual content is primarily historical helper-gallery media; some historical derived files are no longer physically retrievable.

object_identity.note: One editorial rename only: donor 'Tutong and Tamu markets' -> canonical 'Pasarneka Tutong / Tamu Tutong'; same object/slug lineage.

findings: BN/KH/ID/LA/MY contain the rich expedition fields water, overnight_and_camping, accommodation and traveler_reports for all 98 objects in those five countries.
Current canonical QA no longer reports water/overnight/traveler_reports gaps for BN/KH/ID/LA/MY, confirming those donor dimensions survived migration.
MM/PH/SG/TH/TL/VN monoliths are thinner: missing current GPS/elevation/water/overnight/traveler-report/visual-recon fields were not hidden in the old monoliths.

cdn_r1_2026_09_28.missing_scope: Laos historical derived object-detail JSON files; Bolaven Plateau is the only LA standalone detail physically present.
cdn_r1_2026_09_28.rule: Do not reconstruct the missing r1 bytes or retain their old SHA-256 using newer canonical content.

cdn_v2_r3.implication: The manifest proves a richer historical derived read-model existed, but exact missing detail content, especially any ID/MY helper-gallery URLs, cannot be claimed recovered from the current Drive tree.

cdn_v2_reference_zip.role: Separate earlier derivative reference snapshot; not byte-equivalent to r1 or r3.
cdn_v2_reference_zip.note: Useful as a provenance-distinct donor for helper-gallery media. It must not be presented as an exact reconstruction of the missing r1/r3 files.

coordinates_and_elevation.conclusion: The large GPS/elevation QA gaps in PH/SG/TH/TL/VN are research gaps, not migration loss. Coordinates must be researched and sourced under the canonical GPS contract, never inferred from region/city centers.

unique_nonmechanical_categories_beyond_m.disposition: Potentially useful media metadata; preserve only when attached to the same verified media asset.
Editorial ranking only; do not migrate as canonical fact.

helper_media_reconciliation.dedupe_rule: Normalize Wikimedia upload/Special:FilePath/Special:Redirect identity by underlying filename; normalize obvious Wordpress resize variants so alternate sizes are not counted as distinct images.

interpretation.KH: All 19 KH objects already pass gallery QA; 40 old-only assets are historical alternatives, not blockers.
interpretation.BN: 37 old-only assets exist; four currently gallery-blocked BN objects can reach 5 distinct assets using preserved helper media.
interpretation.LA: 27 old-only assets exist; one currently gallery-blocked LA object can reach 5 distinct assets. Tham Piu gains one distinct image but remains below 5.

helper_media_reconciliation.expected_effect_if_assets_still_validate: At most five existing gallery-only QA blockers can be closed directly from preserved historical helper media. Expected passed-object count would rise 38 -> 43 and gallery_min_5 missing count 173 -> 168, subject to media URL/license/mirror validation.

intentional_nonmigration.reason: Current visual_recon contract explicitly forbids photographer instructions and stores only where/when/what equipment category is useful.
Editorial ranking is not a canonical fact and is not required for expedition use.
Derived read-model data must be regenerated from canonical data, not copied as a second source of truth.

remaining_unrecoverable_historical_gaps: 18 exact r1 Laos standalone detail files are absent from Drive; their exact historical bytes and extra detail-only enrichment cannot be claimed reconstructed.
CDN_v2 r3 manifest lists 153 files / 98 objects, but its country/detail tree is absent from Drive. Exact r3-only helper media for ID/MY cannot be enumerated from the remaining metadata.
Any source facts not present in the 11 country monoliths or surviving BN/KH/LA donor details/reference ZIP must be researched anew rather than inferred.
next_actions: Validate and migrate the five QA-closing helper-media sets with explicit provenance to the reference ZIP/underlying source pages.
Optionally attach recoverable gallery descriptions to matching media entities; do not restore editorial scores.
Keep declared r1/r3 historical gaps as provenance gaps; do not fabricate replacement bytes.
After reconciliation recovery, resume object QA using current canonical gaps rather than treating thin raw donor files as missing migrations.
